name: seaside-candle-works
description: Seaside Candle Works — Next.js shop, NestJS API and SQLite database.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
